description: An airline's last 30 days of the flights on record that it operates itself (coverage on_record: the flights on record, not its full schedule): arrivals graded against a published schedule, on-time and late counts, the on-time share, median and 90th-percentile arrival delay (all three only from 20 graded arrivals), landings left ungraded, cancellations, diversions, routes flown, up to five most and least delayed flights, the late rule, and a link to its airline page on gaduin.com.

code.description: Airline IATA code (e.g. BA) or ICAO code (e.g. BAW).

name: get_airline_stats
title: Airline on-time record
